title: Mushroom Sorcerer Vision
description: A surreal psychedelic scene features a large stylized all-seeing eye at the top with a small silhouetted figure inside its pupil. Below, a black shadowy sorcerer with glowing white eyes and purple lightning stands among glowing mushrooms, holding a gnarled staff as a blue bird flies past a dancing silhouette surrounded by swirling rainbow clouds and floating white mushroom caps.
prompt: A surreal psychedelic painting on black background shows a giant stylized eye with eyebrow at the top containing a small silhouetted figure in its pupil. A menacing black shadow sorcerer with glowing white eyes and purple lightning stands in the foreground among glowing mushrooms holding a twisted staff. A blue bird flies across the scene while a black dancing silhouette appears inside a swirling rainbow cloud formation. Floating white mushroom caps fill the upper space with small red dots and figures on a grid background.
